subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for redacted live Telegram owner-session delivery proof, or may maintainers accept the current source/CI proof for this session-routing change?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible and covered by tests, but the user-visible failure is Telegram topic delivery and the PR changes session/message routing where CI does not prove live transport behavior.

options.title: Require Live Telegram Proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing owner-topic completion delivery with isolated heartbeat enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: Merge with source and regression-test evidence only, accepting the risk that real transport/session delivery still misroutes or drops completions.

options.title: Pause For Broader Delivery Contract
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want one canonical completion-wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, cron, and subagent paths before merging targeted fixes.

recommendation.title: Require Live Telegram Proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing owner-topic completion delivery with isolated heartbeat enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has adjacent heartbeat/task-registry history and is a plausible owner for the proof-sufficiency and merge-risk decision.
